@0 n="valence_electron_density" d="Valence-electron count per cell volume, incorporating occupancy." B=704
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    props = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    electrons = 0.0
    occupied = 0.0
    for site in s.get('sites') or []:
        o = site.get('occupancy')
        o = max(0.0, o if o is not None else 1.0)
        occupied += o
        p = props.get(site.get('element')) or {}
        v = p.get('valence_electrons')
        if v is not None:
            electrons += o * max(0.0, v)
    lattice = s.get('lattice') or {}
    volume = lattice.get('volume_A3')
    if volume is None or volume <= 0:
        v = s.get('volume_per_atom_A3')
        volume = v * occupied if v is not None and v > 0 else 0.0
    return electrons / volume if volume > 0 else 0.0
@end
